name: io.github.kecven/scouts-ai-mcp
description: No-key web search API for AI agents. Single web_search tool backed by https://scouts-ai.com. Drop-in for Claude Desktop, Cursor, Open WebUI, Continue, Cline.

environmentVariables.description: SCOUTS-AI API base URL. Defaults to the public no-key endpoint.
environmentVariables.name: SCOUTS_AI_BASE_URL

environmentVariables.description: User-Agent header sent to the API.
environmentVariables.name: SCOUTS_AI_USER_AGENT

environmentVariables.description: Default BCP-47 language code for queries that omit one.
environmentVariables.name: SCOUTS_AI_DEFAULT_LANG

io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.notes: No API key required for default deployment. Verified at submission: GET /api/search returns 200 in ~820ms, rate limit 60/min, no-key.
